description: Give the front-end directive that passes the visitor's scheme to the upstream. DISTILL-CANARY-ca929714

files.conf/header-directives.tsv:
need	canonical	also_accept	recorded_on
visitor-scheme	proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;	proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme|X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme|X-Forwarded-Proto $http_x_forwarded_proto	2026-05-27
visitor-address	proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;	proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for	2026-05-27
files.README.md:
# Quillon Ceramics - storefront front end

The storefront terminates TLS at the edge and forwards plain requests to an application server that
builds absolute links. That server has to know whether the visitor arrived over https.

turns.prompt: Quillon Ceramics terminates TLS at its front end and hands each request to an application server that builds absolute links. Give the front-end directive that carries the scheme the visitor actually used through to that server. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
